scope: one frozen categorical code fit before a positive guard and scored over later fixed-site snapshots

checks.split: count categorical snapshots only; use first TRAIN/GUARD/TEST windows and prefix SITE count; ignore guard symbols, site suffix and later tail
checks.accounting: charge the serialized model once; sum separately framed test snapshots and raw references; preserve time and sequence boundaries
checks.frozen: guard or tail mutation changes no cost; a changed first test snapshot cannot alter the model or savings on the following frame
checks.status: reject varying declared fixed-site shape and corrupt trailing input; report insufficient data for short windows, missing sites or repeated time; report unsupported for absent or nonfixed sites and enforce resource limits
checks.install: verify the API, independent fixture and unchanged earlier outputs on all three conformance platforms

limits: engineering fixture for observed snapshot order and disjoint regions. No claim of statistical independence, temporal prediction, or scientific calibration.
